g.text: content="YukiOS is a free browser-based desktop environment with a tiling window manager, macOS-style interface, 3000 games, a terminal with Python & Git, emulators for DOS/Flash/x86/3DS, and 90+ apps - no sign-up or download required. Open source with MIT license."
<meta property="og:title" content="YukiOS - Free Desktop Environment in Your Browser, No Download Needed" />

content="Turn your browser into a full desktop OS with YukiOS. Tiling window manager, Mac desktop mode, 3000 free games, Python/Node terminal, DOS/Flash/x86 emulators, 90+ apps - all in one browser tab."
<meta name="twitter:title" content="YukiOS - Free Desktop Environment in Your Browser, No Install Needed" />
